title: Civil Manager
description:
**The Opportunity**
 The Civil Lead Manager has a responsibility for a given team’s operation, resource allocation, development of competence and people development. This role involves managing all aspects of civil works from planning and design to execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* Lead, manage, and supervise all civil engineering activities across various projects, ensuring adherence to project specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Develop, review, and approve civil engineering designs, drawings, and specifications, ensuring technical accuracy and constructability. Prepare and manage project budgets, schedules, and resource allocation for civil works, monitoring progress and implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Oversee site inspections, quality control, and safety procedures for civil construction, ensuring compliance with company policies and best practices.
* Manage and coordinate with contractors, sub\-contractors, and suppliers for civil works, ensuring effective communication and performance.
* Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for civil engineering projects.
* Prepare and present regular project reports to senior management, highlighting project status, challenges, and proposed solutions.
* Mentor and develop a team of civil engineers and technical staff.
* Collaborate with other engineering disciplines and project stakeholders to ensure seamless project integration.
* Stay updated with the latest civil engineering technologies, standards, and best practices.
* Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in civil engineering project management, with at least 5 years in a managerial role.
* Proven track record of successfully delivering complex civil engineering projects, preferably in the power or infrastructure sector.
* Strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, construction methods, materials, and relevant national and international codes and standards.
* Proficiency in project management software and relevant civil engineering design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Civil 3D).
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work effectively under pressure.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Data Modeller - Data Vault - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Functional Data Modeller and Analyst – Insurance (Manager)**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking an experienced Manager \- Techno\-Functional Data Modeller \& Business Analyst with deep expertise in Insurance Data Management, Data Modelling, Business Analysis, Reporting \& Analytics, Data Governance, and Data Migration.
   

  

 The successful candidate will lead complex data transformation initiatives, manage stakeholder relationships across business and technology functions, and provide thought leadership in designing enterprise\-scale data solutions. This role requires a blend of consulting, delivery leadership, data architecture understanding, and hands\-on data vault modelling expertise.
   

  

 The individual will be responsible for driving data strategy, ensuring delivery excellence, managing client engagements, mentoring teams, and supporting business growth initiatives within the EY Data and Analytics practice.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Analysis \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, and data strategy discussions with senior stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with business sponsors, SMEs, architects, and delivery teams.
* Provide strategic recommendations on data platforms, reporting solutions, migration approaches, and governance frameworks.
* Support proposal development, solution design, estimations, and client presentations.


**Delivery Leadership \& Programme Management**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of data transformation, migration, reporting, and modernization programmes.
* Manage multiple workstreams while ensuring alignment with programme objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Proactively identify and mitigate programme risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure successful delivery across SIT, UAT, cutover, and production deployment phases.


**Business Analysis \& Data Consulting**
* Lead business and data discovery activities across insurance projects.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, data models, reporting solutions, and transformation requirements.
* Conduct impact assessments, gap analysis, and process improvement initiatives.
* Define business rules, validation frameworks, reconciliation rules, and data quality controls.
* Support operational and strategic decision\-making through data\-driven insights.


**Data Management \& Data Governance**
* Define and implement enterprise data governance standards and best practices.
* Drive data quality, metadata management, master data management, and lineage initiatives.
* Establish data stewardship processes and governance forums.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and risk management requirements.
* Support enterprise data strategy and target\-state data architecture initiatives.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Lead requirements gathering for dashboards, KPIs, scorecards, and analytical solutions.
* Design reporting datasets, semantic layers, and reporting data models.
* Support self\-service BI and data democratization initiatives.


**Data Migration \& Integration**
* Create source\-to\-target mappings, migration strategies, and reconciliation frameworks.
* Drive migration governance, issue management, and stakeholder sign\-offs.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure successful implementation.
* Establish best practices for migration quality, auditability, and controls.


**People Leadership \& Practice Development**
* Lead and mentor teams of Data Analysts, Data Modellers, Consultants, and Senior Consultants.
* Support recruitment, resource planning, capability development, and performance management.
* Provide coaching and technical leadership across client engagements.
* Contribute to EY's Data \& Analytics practice through accelerators, methodologies, reusable assets, and thought leadership.
* Support business development activities, RFP responses, and solution architecture proposals.


**Mandatory Skills \& Experience**
**Insurance Domain Expertise**
* Strong understanding of insurance business processes and data structures.
* Experience in Policy Administration, Underwriting, Claims, Billing \& Finance, Customer Management, Broker Management and Reinsurance


**Data Modelling (Mandatory)**
* Minimum 7\+ years of hands\-on data modelling experience.
* Strong expertise in Data Vault 2\.0, Dimensional Modelling, Relational Data Modelling, Data Warehousing, Enterprise Data Architecture
* Experience with modelling tools at least in one of the following – Erwin, ER/Studio, SAP PowerDesigner or Lucidchart


**Reporting \& BI Tools**
* Hands\-on experience with one or more reporting and analytics platforms like Power BI, MicroStrategy (MSTR), Tableau, Qlik Sense/QlikView, SSRS


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced SQL (mandatory)
* Strong understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT Processes, Data Integration, APIs and Data Interfaces
* Experience with databases like SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Azure SQL
* Exposure to at least one cloud platforms: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


**Experience**
* 10\-15\+ years of experience in Data Consulting, Data Management, Business Analysis, Data Migration, and Analytics.
* 7\+ years of Data Modelling experience, including extensive Data Vault 2\.0 implementation experience.
* Proven experience leading large\-scale data transformation and migration programmes.
* Experience within the UK Insurance market, including General Insurance, London Market Insurance, Syndicate and MGA environments London Market Insurance


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Summary**
 Sr Consultant role requiring eight to ten years of experience in Property and Casualty Insurance focused on delivering high quality consulting outcomes in a hybrid work model during day shifts without travel requirements enabling clients to improve underwriting claims and policy servicing efficiency while supporting the organization mission of responsible and sustainable growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive end to end consulting engagements for Property and Casualty Insurance clients to optimize underwriting rating and claims operations while aligning solutions with strategic business objectives and regulatory expectations.
* Analyze complex policy administration billing and claims processes to identify operational bottlenecks and design practical process improvements that enhance service quality and reduce handling time.
* Collaborate closely with client business stakeholders and technology partners to translate insurance domain requirements into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation.
* Develop detailed requirement documents process maps and user stories that capture rating logic coverage structures and claims handling rules in a format that can be readily implemented by delivery teams.
* Guide clients through target operating model definition for Property and Casualty portfolios by assessing current capabilities identifying gaps and proposing phased roadmaps for transformation initiatives.
* Perform impact assessments for changes in underwriting guidelines regulatory mandates and product structures and recommend mitigation plans that minimize disruption to ongoing business operations.
* Configure and validate insurance platform solutions such as policy administration components rating engines or claims modules to ensure they reflect agreed business rules and coverage features.
* Conduct system and user acceptance testing of Property and Casualty solutions by preparing test scenarios executing test cases logging defects and validating fixes against business expectations.
* Prepare and deliver clear client ready presentations status reports and workshops that explain findings options and recommendations in a structured and actionable manner for various stakeholder groups.
* Support production rollout activities by coordinating user training process documentation and post implementation reviews to ensure stable adoption and measurable business benefits.
* Mentor junior consultants in Property and Casualty concepts artifacts and best practices enabling them to contribute effectively to client engagements and strengthen overall team capability.
* Work within hybrid teams across locations and time zones to ensure that design decisions configuration changes and defect resolutions are documented consistently and communicated promptly.
* Align all consulting activities with organizational policies on ethics compliance data privacy and risk management ensuring that client outcomes contribute positively to societal trust in the insurance ecosystem.


**Qualifications**
* Possess eight to ten years of hands on experience in Property and Casualty Insurance across areas such as underwriting policy administration claims or billing with a strong understanding of personal and commercial lines products.
* Demonstrate practical knowledge of core insurance concepts including rating factors coverage limits deductibles endorsements reinsurance and loss control practices applied in daily consulting work.
* Exhibit proven experience working on transformation or system implementation projects for insurance carriers managing requirements testing and rollout activities in a structured consulting environment.
* Apply strong analytical and problem solving skills to interpret data from policy systems claims repositories or financial reports and convert insights into actionable recommendations for clients.
* Utilize excellent communication and workshop facilitation skills to engage diverse stakeholders such as underwriters claims handlers actuaries and technology specialists in hybrid work settings.
* Show familiarity with modern insurance platforms or digital solutions such as policy administration suites claims management tools or customer service portals used in Property and Casualty initiatives.
* Display comfort with working in a hybrid work model that combines onsite and remote collaboration while maintaining productivity during day shifts without requiring travel.

 As a member of NCR VOYIX Telecom Engineering team the Genesys Telecom Engineer will have responsibility for designing, engineering, implementing and supporting Genesys cloud infrastructure in a global multi\-location contact center, corporate and branch office environment.  :

 :
   

  

 Three years’ experience (Grade 10\) Five years (Grade 11\), Seven years (Grade 12\) with voice infrastructure design and support in a Genesys environment with scripting and advanced features. Experience with multi\-site configurations in system engineering and administration role. Telecom engineering including VoIP design and architecture.
   

  

**Primary Technical Skills:**

* Experience with PureInsights reporting platform

title: Supply Chain Performance Specialist
description:
**Vestas has a prominent position in wind technology and a Defining\-force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas' core business comprises of Development, Manufacturing, Sales, Marketing and Service of Wind Turbines. Come and Join us at Vestas!**
**Technology \& Operations \> Supply Chain \> Performance Management**
 The SIOP Performance Management team improves operational performance and execution excellence across the Service Supply Chain. Acting as a bridge between Planning, Commercial, Logistics, Procurement, and Service functions, the team ensures alignment on business priorities and enables effective end\-to\-end execution.
   

  

 The department oversees performance management, Sales \& Operations Execution (S\&OE), data governance, process improvement, automation, and business intelligence. By combining cross\-functional collaboration with data\-driven insights, the team supports revenue enablement, service availability, and continuous improvement across the global Service organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Improve supply chain performance through effective master data governance, process optimization, and automation initiatives
* Analyze master data structures and business rules to identify opportunities for improved planning accuracy, inventory optimization, and service performance
* Partner with Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, and Operations stakeholders to ensure data supports business objectives
* Perform root cause analysis and corrective actions for supply chain performance issues linked to data, processes, or system setup
* Define and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and improve process efficiency
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by leveraging digital tools, automation, and data\-driven decision making
* Govern key master data domains and ensure data quality standards across global supply chain processes
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize supply chain processes across regions and functions


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field
* 5\+ years of experience within Supply Chain, Planning, Operations, Master Data, or Performance Management
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end supply chain processes and their interaction with planning, inventory, and service performance
* Experience working in a global business environment
* History of improving processes and business results through data\-driven insights
* Experience working with ERP systems, SAP S/4HANA


**Competencies**
* Deep knowledge of master data management and its effect on supply chain performance
* Experience working with SAP master data objects and supply chain\-relevant data structures, including Material, Location, Vendor, and Customer Master Data
* Advanced Excel skills and experience using digital tools for business analysis
* Understanding of inventory management, planning concepts, and supply chain optimization
* Experience with automation tools, reporting solutions, or process digitization initiatives
* Ability to connect business requirements with system and data solutions
* Strategic mindset with the ability to connect operational details to business outcomes
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics in a simple manner
* Curious and improvement\-oriented approach
* Highly organized approach marked by initiative and follow\-through
* Comfortable questioning established processes and helping bring about change
* Able to navigate ambiguity and work across organizational boundaries


**What We Offer**
 Our company offers an engaging position with great opportunities to grow both professionally and personally in an inspiring workplace at a top producer of wind turbines worldwide. We highly value initiative, responsibility and the right balance between creativity and quality in all solutions. You will become part of a highly professional environment with a deep business commitment.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Your primary location will be in Chennai, India
   

  

 Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 30th Sep 2026
   

  

 Learn more about Vestas at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels
   

  

**Our commitment to a fair hiring.**
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
   

  

**DEIB Statement**
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
   

  

**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
 It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our\-recruitment\-process
   

  

**About Vestas**
 Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
   

  

 Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40\+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
   

  

 With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
   

  

 Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
   

  

 To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Windchill PTC – Consultant, Technical Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
 Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations improve business performance by connecting strategy, operations, and technology across product development, supply chain, and enterprise platforms. We work with clients to deliver digital transformation initiatives that improve efficiency, strengthen processes, and support scalable business outcomes.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will support Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and technical transformation efforts with a focus on Windchill and the broader PTC ecosystem. Our professionals help clients modernize product data, enhance engineering and change processes, and integrate PLM solutions with enterprise systems to drive more connected and effective operations.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 As an experienced Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Design, develop, and customize end\-to\-end Windchill product lifecycle management (PLM) solutions across migration, configuration, and integration workstreams
* Configure Windchill components including lifecycles, workflows, change management, business rules, and bill of materials management to support business requirements
* Develop and support integrations between Windchill and enterprise systems such as SAP, computer\-aided design (CAD) platforms, and visualization tools
* Build and support technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML) within Windchill environments
* Support testing, validation, and deployment activities across development, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and production environments


**The team**
 Enterprise Performance
   

  

 Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions.
   

  

 The Enterprise Performance team leverages deep industry knowledge, strong analytical skills, and practical approaches to address clients’ toughest business challenges. Our professionals as part of the Supply Chain Network Operations (SCNO) service line within Enterprise Performance focus on helping organizations achieve sustainable competitive advantage throughout their operations, spanning product development, planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution. We excel at translating strategic objectives into tangible, measurable outcomes at the operational level. By aligning high\-level goals with frontline execution, we ensure our clients realize real value and improved performance across every stage of their supply chain and operations.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 3\-6 years of experience in Windchill data migration using Windchill Bulk Migrator (WBM) or custom migration utilities
* Experience delivering 2\-3 end\-to\-end Windchill implementation and data migration projects
* Experience with computer\-aided design (CAD) data migration for SolidWorks and AutoCAD
* Experience configuring Windchill 10\.x and 11\.x, including business configuration, change management, workflows, and bill of materials management
* Experience developing or supporting Windchill technical solutions using Java, Java 2 Platform, Enterprise Edition (J2EE), JavaScript, and Extensible Markup Language (XML)
* Experience reviewing or supporting PLM code, integration configurations, install scripts, build scripts, deployment scripts, cron jobs, and custom utilities across development, quality assurance, and production environments
* Experience in automotive, manufacturing, or consumer goods industries


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with multiple product lifecycle management (PLM) frameworks
* Experience creating business solution assets
* Experience aligning PLM enterprise architecture to client roadmaps
* Experience using planning tools or enterprise resource planning platforms such as Oracle, SAP, o9, Kinaxis, or Anaplan
* Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree or equivalent from an accredited university

 **Techno\-Functional Data Consultant**

* Ensure alignment between business processes and target data architecture.
* Collaborate with solution architects and development teams to implement data models.
* Work closely with ETL, Data Engineering, and Development teams to ensure requirements are accurately implemented.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Data Modelling Skills**
* Demonstrable experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
* Proficiency with data modelling tools such as ERwin, ER/Studio, SAP PowerDesigner, Lucidchart, Visio, or similar.
* Strong understanding of relational databases and data architecture principles.
* Experience creating and maintaining enterprise data models and data dictionaries.


**Functional Skills**
* Strong understanding of insurance business processes and data.
* Experience working on policy, customer, claims, underwriting, or broker data domains.
* Proven experience in requirements gathering, business analysis, and stakeholder management.

**Data Skills**

* Understanding of data governance and master data management principles.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more reporting and analytics platforms like Power BI, MicroStrategy (MSTR), Tableau, Qlik Sense/QlikView

**Technical Skills**
* Experience working with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar.
* Understanding of data warehousing and ETL concepts.
* Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and cloud\-based data platforms


**Good to Have**
* Experience within the UK Insurance market, including General Insurance, London Market Insurance, Syndicate and MGA environments


**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Data Consulting, or Data Migration roles.
* Minimum 5\+ years of hands\-on data modelling experience.
* Insurance domain experience preferred.
* UK Insurance market experience highly desirable.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Strong project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
 People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
   

  

**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

**EY \| Building a better working world**

title: Program Manager II, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Program Manager to join our rapidly growing team. The role is centered on developing insights and eliminating defects in quality that affects business metrics. As part of this role, you will work on 1\) Creating mechanisms to identify, investigate, and solve quality issues impacting the business metrics, 2\) Working collaboratively across our partner teams (ex: Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) to combine efforts to solve problems, 3\) Developing data\-driven approaches alongside our SWOT/BA teams to rapidly identify opportunity areas, and trends at scale, 4\) You will take complex opportunities and break them down into manageable pieces, then ensure timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities

* Drive appropriate data\-oriented analysis, adoption of technology solutions and process improvement projects to achieve operational and business goal
* Communicate and take the lead role in identifying Gaps in process areas and work with all stakeholders to resolve the gaps
* Be a SME for the process and a referral point for in\-house and customer team

* Ability to meet deadlines in a fast\-paced work environment driven by complex software systems and processes

* Shall collaborate effectively with customers (Science, Engineering, Product, etc.) to bring in improvements to the business metrics
* Provide regular updates on project progress and performance, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals.
* Exercise discretion in prioritizing process improvements, aligning them with broader business objectives.
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained. Implement corrective actions and maintain commitment to goals, ensuring on\-time project completion and minimized losses.
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices to promote long\-term solutions in dynamic environments.
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Bachelor's degree


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.

title: Forward Deployed AI Strategist {Chennai}
description:
**About DevRev**
 At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
 *Computer* 
 – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
 *Computer* 
 unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI\-ready platform, giving employees real\-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI\-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human\-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M\+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a
 **Forward Deployed AI Strategist** 
 , you will serve as the lead technical strategist embedded with our customers. You'll own the end\-to\-end design of AI\-driven business transformation projects from understanding domain\-specific needs to architecting scalable agent\-based solutions using DevRev’s platform. This role requires a unique blend of enterprise architecture, AI solutioning, customer empathy, and cross\-functional collaboration. You’ll act as the connective tissue between pre\-sales, customer success, engineering, and product teams bringing our AI capabilities to life for real\-world impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own Customer Context: Deeply understand customer business domains, systems, and OKRs/KPIs to guide solution design.
* Architect AI Transformation: Design and document AI\-driven workflows, agents, skills, and system integrations that align with customer goals and industry best practices.
* Be a Trusted Advisor: Build strong partnerships with customer stakeholders as their technical counterpart, delivering confidence in our platform’s capabilities.
* Translate \& Coordinate: Bridge the gap between pre\-sales/CS and engineering, ensuring requirements are actionable and outcomes measurable.
* Design Reusability: Architect modular, scalable solutions that can be extended across customers and verticals.
* Drive Delivery: Collaborate with Applied AI engineers to oversee solution implementation, ensuring architectural alignment and execution excellence.
* Support Pre\-Sales: Partner with sales engineers and customer teams to scope new opportunities, define technical requirements, and provide input on feasibility and effort.
* Lead Innovation: Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI, software integration, and business transformation—and bring that insight to our solution designs.
* Maintain Quality \& Compliance: Ensure all solutions meet performance, security, and compliance standards.


**What You'll Bring**
* Experience: 7\+ years in solution architecture or consulting roles, focused on enterprise\-scale, customer\-facing software implementations.
* AI \& Cloud: Hands\-on experience with generative AI tools, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and modern integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, pipelines).
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of customer priorities, with the ability to translate business needs into technical execution plans.
* Design Thinking: A problem\-solver with a growth mindset, skilled in crafting scalable and future\-proof architectures.
* Communication: Exceptional ability to convey complex technical and business concepts to diverse stakeholders, both technical and non\-technical.
* Project Leadership: Proficiency with project planning tools and methodologies; capable of managing multiple solution tracks and timelines.
* Metrics Focus: Proven ability to define and track success through OKRs, KPIs, and tangible business outcomes.
* SaaS \& Platform Fluency: Background in SaaS or enterprise platforms, with understanding of extensibility and multi\-tenant design principles.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in AI/architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, SAFe) are a plus.


**Travel Ready:** 
**Willingness to travel up to 80% for on\-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.**

* Networks and connects with internal and external personnel in own area of expertise


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 5\-8 years of relevant experience or 9\-12 years of relevant work experience
* Home office experience of minimum 3\-5 years as a scheduler/ planner in a large scale EPC project


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience in performing, monitoring, and reviewing planning and scheduling functions, which include schedule development, control, and analysis in EPC projects.
* Skilled in oral and written communication.
* Knowledge of engineering and construction management customarily acquired over time through specialized instruction or practical experience.
* Skilled in understanding technical processes, engineering drawings, quantity determinations, and financial reports.
* Proficiency with PC operating systems, including Primavera. Proficiency with multiple discipline\-specific software applications currently used (Microsoft Office Applications, for example)

To contribute to a compliance culture on key laws, regulations and Group standards in Wealth \& Retail Banking and at the same time, ensuring adequate mechanisms and prompt reporting of breaches to relevant Risk Forums and Legal \& Compliance unit.

* Delivery against agreed service standards (TAT, Accuracy, Referrals) including all financial settlements to all external entities.
* Service management through forums like JSR’s discussing service trends, key business strategies and actions required to be taken
* Revenue accounting, tax compliance and sustainable cost plus recharge model
* Deepen end to end digital capabilities from Multi touch to single touch to zero touch processing


**Cost Management**
* Manage costs within Budgets/Forecasts and deliver against budget targets for cost saves
* Monitor cost trends / unit cost and identify opportunities for reducing the same through automation and other initiatives
* Monitor and track margin trends and maintain at optimal levels at all times
* Futuristic estimation of costs and provide budget/forecast inputs
* Review and approve spends in line with delegated authorities and as per Group policy and procedures.
* Manage the cost centres efficiently wherein designated as cost centre owner.


**People and Talent**
* Ensuring talent on boarding and retention with succession plan in place for key roles and maintaining healthy bench\-strength and leadership pipeline
* Ensuring framework for objective performance assessment of all team members
* Ensuring right\-skilling and Cross Skilling among team members and training /certification for specific roles
* Enabling a conducive environment for people including effective engagement
* Empowering with appropriate delegated authorities


**Risk Management**
* Proactive identification, preventive controls and mitigation of key process / operational risks
* Strong detective controls and continuous learning and fixing from risk incidents
* Ensuring timely reporting of risk items as per the Group Risk Management Framework
* Drive risk management initiatives across the unit resulting in minimal or zero breaches and zero regulatory breaches whether data related or others
* Ensuring adherence to all Group Policies and Procedures and adequate training to staff to ensure compliance at all times
* Ensuring business continuity strategies are in place and tested at regular intervals as per standards agreed with country stake holders
* Approving existing BAU process documents (DOI/PCA) and UAT test results. \-
* Ensure Risk Assessment template is filled and signed off by Head of Unit before BAU adoption of any new process or amendment of an existing process.


**Transformation \& Service excellence**

* Review and drive strategic opportunities in transformation to adopt exception processing operating model.
* Support and lead change initiatives and provide feedback for change proposals
* Deliver sustainable cost saves and service levels on par with or superior to competition


**Leadership**
* Contribute to overall WRB Operations leadership forum
* Set strategic goals including Aspirational goals and guide teams for achieving results
* Support growth and development opportunities for talent management and retention
* Engage key stakeholders and support functions for strategic initiatives and transformation


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**

* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. **Skills And Experience**
* Communication and Interpersonal
* Technical and Analytical
* Project management
* Team Management
* Risk Management
* Strategic Planning

* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

description:
**About the Role** 




  





 Own the end\-to\-end SAP and enterprise applications landscape for the organization. Drive digital transformation, process standardization, and operational excellence across manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and commercial functions. Identify and implement new technologies to leverage IT for business benefits. Act as the strategic partner to business leaders and the Sr. GM IT / CFO for all SAP\-related initiatives.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* **Strategy \& Governance**



  




* Define and execute the SAP roadmap aligned to business strategy, including S/4 HANA evolution, RISE / cloud strategy and integration with non\-SAP systems
* Establish governance frameworks for change management, release management, master data, security, and compliance (including DPDP Act and internal controls
* Drive process standardization and best practices across plants and business units, leveraging SAP standard functionality wherever possible



  




* **Delivery \& Operations**



  




* Lead end\-to\-end SAP implementations, upgrades, and migrations (ECC → S/4HANA, Greenfield / Brownfield), ensuring on\-time, on\-budget delivery with quality
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of SAP and key business applications (ITIL/SDLC\-based), including incident, problem, and change management, and vendor
* Ensure seamless integration between SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM, WM/EWM, PS, etc.) and with MES, SCADA, PLM, BI, and other enterprise systems.



  




* **Manufacturing \& Domain Leadership**



  




* Partner with COO, Plant Heads, and Supply Chain leaders to align SAP architecture with production planning, capacity planning, shop\-floor automation, and MRP processes
* Provide deep expertise in discrete / process manufacturing concepts: BOMs, routing, work centers, production orders, quality inspections, maintenance plans, and cost controlling
* Drive digital manufacturing initiatives (e.g., shop\-floor data capture, IoT integration, advanced analytics, AI/ML, RPA) on SAP BTP and allied platforms



  




* **Team \& Vendor Management**



  




* Build and lead a high\-performing team of functional, technical, and basis consultants, as well as support staff; drive capability building and succession planning
* Manage relationships with system integrators, vendors, and partners, negotiating contracts, monitoring performance, and ensuring value realization



  




* **Risk, Security \& Compliance**



  




* Own application security, role design, SoD controls, and data protection in line with corporate policies and regulatory requirements
* Ensure audit readiness and support internal/external audits with appropriate documentation and controls



  




* **Reporting and Relationships**



  




* **Reports to:**
* Sr. GM (IT) / CFO



  




* **Direct reports:**
* SAP functional leads, technical leads, support managers, and project managers



  




* **Key stakeholders:**
* COO, Plant Heads, CFO, CHRO, Supply Chain Head, Quality Head, and external partners



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Qualifications \& Experience
* 15–20 years in SAP and enterprise applications, with at least 2 full\-cycle SAP implementations in complex manufacturing setups
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP S/4 HANA (implementation and / or migration) and deep knowledge of core modules: FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, QM, PM; exposure to PS, WM /EWM, and Group Reporting is preferred
* Proven track record managing large teams (10\+) and multi\-plant, multi\-location rollouts



  




* **Education**
* Graduate or Postgraduate in Engineering, Finance, Marketing or Material Management



  





**Required Skills** 



* Skills and Competencies
* Domain: Manufacturing operations, supply chain, finance \& controlling, project systems, and plant maintenance
* Technical: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, SAP BTP, integration middleware, basic ABAP understanding, analytics (e.g., SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Superset / Grafana)
* Leadership: Strategic thinking, stakeholder management, negotiation, team building, and executive communication
* Transformation: Digital transformation, automation (RPA / AI), cloud strategies (SAP RISE), and continuous improvement mindset

 Translate business challenges into high\-value transformation initiatives and actionable business cases. Partner with business, operations, and technology stakeholders to assess, prioritize, and support strategic initiatives.

* 3\-7 years of experience in Asset Management, Investment Management, Wealth Management, Capital Markets, Asset Servicing, Financial Services Consulting, or related transformation and strategy roles.

* Investment Operations
* Fund Accounting
* Asset Servicing
* Trade Lifecycle Management
* Performance \& Attribution
* Investment Reporting
* Portfolio Operations

* Strong analytical, research, problem\-solving, and structured thinking capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively with senior business and technology stakeholders in a fast\-paced, transformation\-driven environment.

title: Project Quality Specialist
description:
FE fundinfo is a global leader in investment fund data and technology. We are proud of our vast, diverse, and highly skilled team, who help to make our industry Better Connected and Better Informed.
   

  

 The Client Experience team plays a pivotal role in collaborating with business development and account managers throughout the client's journey. As one of the most substantial divisions at FE fundinfo, the Client Experience department is tasked with the effective execution of projects within the company's portfolio. Encompassing client support, data support, GFRS, managed services and the client success team, our objective is to provide unparalleled client service. The function of Client Experience is to guarantee that our clients receive the utmost value and satisfaction from our products and services.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing and supporting the locally based Project Quality team within the Client Delivery Team. The Project Quality Specialist will share knowledge and experience within the team to ensure that the team follows best practices and provide advice where needed.
   

  

 As a Project Quality Specialist you will be responsible for overseeing the Test Phases within projects that are being tested by your Test Team direct reports; thereby ensuring that the client is provided the highest quality assurance.
   

  

 The role will also form part of an operating model for existing services provided to clients. As a Project Quality Specialist you will have a strong test management knowledge and will be able to provide support to other Project Quality Specialists to ensure the highest quality in Integration and System Testing.
   

  

**Your key responsibilities as a Project Quality Specialist will be to:**
* Communicate escalations to manager where appropriate.
* Nurture an inspiring team environment with an open communication culture.
* Continuously develop and optimise team processes to improve overall performance.
* Assist with the preparation of project test plans that outlines the test objectives, schedule, deliverables, test environment setup. It serves as a blueprint for the testing activities and ensures that the team follows a structured approach.
* Collaborate with the test team and project team to create test scenarios and cases that cover all the possible functionalities and requirements of the configured application. They ensure that the test cases are comprehensive and effective and adhere to the test strategy.
* Review test artefacts, such as test cases, test scripts and test data, to ensure their quality, consistency and adherence to the test strategy and plan.
* Consolidate and analyse the findings and prepare comprehensive test reports. These reports highlight the defects found, their severity and the overall quality of the configured application.
* Track and manage defects using a defect tracking system, liaising with developers to resolve defects promptly.
* Assess the effectiveness of the testing process, identify areas for improvement and implement changes to enhance the quality and efficiency of the testing activities.
* To adhere to all general security responsibilities as documented in the company security policy


**To join us as a Project Quality Specialist you will need the following experience and skills:**
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* At least 1 years' experience with test management or similar
* Ability to work with data effectively to ensure quality testing
* Experience with project processes and procedures
* Experience with analysing and compiling data for reporting purposes
* Good technical knowledge/background


**By joining the team as a Project Quality Specialist, you will be offered the following:**
* 24 days holiday
* Paid Study leave
* Enhanced paternity \& maternity
* Statutory benefits like PF, Gratuity, etc
* Support to set up home office
* Health cover with option to add family members
* Annual health check up
* Meal cards
* Full LinkedIn Learning access


**Apply today for immediate consideration and we will endeavour to get back to you within 5 working days. Visit our Glassdoor profile or fefundinfo.com to find out more about life @ FE fundinfo!**

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
**Job Description**
 Cost Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain project cost budgets in accordance with the Project Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and the Basis of Estimate
* Liaise with procurement, finance, and time\-capture functions to ensure accurate and timely capture of all cost elements — procurement, materials, subcontracts, and labour
* Monitor and review cost commitments and expenditure through all phases of project lifecycle
* Liaise with project management and planning to ensure accuracy of cost phasing and forecasting
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports and forecast updates
* Review and analyse cost impact of manpower forecasts
* Review and issue project change orders and variations in accordance with change notifications
* Assess and communicate cost and schedule impact of change notifications
* Monitor overall project cost performance and contingency drawdown
* Lead the project cost close\-out process
* Act as Cost Focal Point for all assigned project scopes


 Reporting \& Governance
   

  

* Ensure project budgets, costs, and reports are documented, auditable, and issued in a controlled manner
* Review and evaluate project cost performance reports in accordance with project reporting requirements
* Attend project and client periodic meetings and present cost performance status as required
* Ensure reports are accurate, timely, and issued in accordance with the contract reporting calendar
* Ensure original and current budgets correspond to approved estimates and scope changes throughout the project lifecycle
* Participate in contract and corporate risk analysis sessions and audits


 PMBS \& Efficiency
   

  

* Support the achievement of the contract PMBS efficiency target (target: PMBS below 50% of Engineering cost)
* Actively contribute to simplification of cost reporting structures and reduction of unnecessary reporting overhead
* Contribute to the development of fit\-for\-purpose cost controls for the Fast Track delivery model


 Team \& Capability Development
   

  

* Supervise, guide, and manage the Cost team — delegating work, reviewing outputs, and supporting development
* Play a key role in mentoring and career development of cost personnel within the GEC
* Lead and participate in Project Controls compliance and continuous improvement reviews
* Contribute to the recruiting and retention of project controls talent within the GEC Hub


**Contract\-specific Requirements**
 Location \& Mobility
   

  

* Based at the Wood GEC office in Chennai, India — this is the primary place of work
* Willingness and ability to undertake periodic overseas travel, primarily to the UK (Aberdeen), for project governance, knowledge transfer, customer engagement, and team alignment purposes
* Estimated overseas travel: low frequency (approximately 2–4 trips per year depending on project phase)


 International \& Multicultural Experience
   

  

* Demonstrated experience working in multicultural environments — experience working or collaborating with teams in Europe (particularly the UK) is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to operate effectively across cultural, organizational, and time\-zone boundaries
* Experience of UK North Sea or comparable European offshore oil and gas operations is advantageous


 Brownfield Experience
   

  

* Preference for candidates with previous brownfield offshore modification or brownfield EPC project experience
* Familiarity with the particular challenges of brownfield scope definition, execution in operating environments, and interface management with asset operations teams


 Transition \& Uncertainty Leadership
   

  

* Demonstrable ability to lead teams through periods of significant change, transition, and operating model evolution
* Comfortable operating with managed uncertainty — able to keep teams focused, motivated, and delivering during periods when processes, structures, or accountabilities are still maturing
* Experience of operating model transitions, onboarding programmes, or significant organizational change is advantageous


 Workload Flexibility
   

  

* Ability to manage varied and changing workloads across multiple concurrent scopes of differing scale and complexity
* Comfortable moving between strategic planning, hands\-on delivery support, and team leadership as the situation requires


 Networking \& Talent Development
   

  

* Strong professional networking capability — able to identify, attract, and retain talent within the GEC and the wider Wood organization
* Active approach to building an internal talent pipeline, mentoring junior team members, and contributing to the development of the GEC as a center of excellence
* Contribution to the wider recruiting effort for the GEC Hub build\-out is expected


**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or business discipline (or equivalent through relevant vocational training and industry experience)


**Knowledge, Skills, And Experience**
* Minimum 8 years of relevant cost control experience
* Excellent knowledge of cost software, budgeting, forecasting, and cash\-flow management
* Advanced knowledge of Project Execution Procedures for Cost Management including Change Management
* Excellent understanding of WBS and CBS structures, earned value application, and cost/schedule variance analysis
* Prior experience in a senior cost role, with team management experience
* Experience of offshore oil and gas project delivery — brownfield experience strongly preferred


 Personal Attributes
   

  

* Analytically rigorous with strong attention to accuracy and auditability
* Proactive communicator — raises issues early and clearly
* Able to work autonomously and within a team across multiple time zones
* Committed to continuous improvement and process simplification
* Strong organizational and planning skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent scopes


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting, engineering and operations for the energy and materials sectors. With 33,000 people in around 50 countries, Wood supports clients across the full asset lifecycle, delivering safe, predictable outcomes while enabling resilient operations and a lower carbon future. Wood forms the Energy \& Materials pillar of Sidara \- a global partnership uniting leading multidisciplinary engineering, design, and project management companies. www.woodgroup.com

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**About Metayb**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. We have grown into a close\-knit family of
 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Supply Chain Manager** 
 to manage and coordinate end\-to\-end
 **logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations** 
 across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on
 **Saudi Arabia and Egypt** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the
 **Head of Logistics** 
 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication of shipment status, operational challenges, delays, and critical escalations.
* Escalate significant logistics and supply chain issues to the appropriate stakeholders with relevant information and recommended actions.
* Support effective stakeholder communication to ensure continuity and smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with logistics partners to support reliable transportation and service delivery.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 15–20 years of experience in logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, or supply chain operations.
* Strong experience working in manufacturing, factory, warehouse, distribution, or FMCG environments.
* Extensive experience in shipment planning, transportation coordination, logistics operations, and supply chain management.
* Experience managing logistics operations across international or multinational markets is preferred.
* Candidates with strong exposure to Middle East and Africa logistics operations will be preferred.
* Arabic\-speaking candidates will be given priority.


**Required Skills**
* Strong understanding of transportation, logistics, distribution, and end\-to\-end supply chain processes.
* Strong hands\-on experience with SAP and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Experience in logistics reporting, shipment tracking, freight management, and transportation coordination.
* Strong knowledge of dispatch planning, delivery management, warehouse coordination, and transportation operations.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, coordination, and relationship management skills.
* Strong customer\-service orientation with the ability to manage internal and external relationships effectively.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on process governance, operational control, and supply chain visibility.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and operational challenges in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Strong ownership and accountability for shipment execution, delivery commitments, and logistics performance.
* Ability to work effectively with multi\-national teams and stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Strong understanding of freight management and shipment tracking systems.
* Arabic language proficiency will be a significant advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to logistics and supply chain operations across the Middle East and Africa region.
* Experience managing shipments to Saudi Arabia, Egypt, GCC countries, or African markets.
* Experience working with international transportation vendors and logistics partners.
* Strong exposure to SAP\-based supply chain and logistics operations.
* Arabic language proficiency.
* Experience supporting or working closely with a Head of Logistics, Supply Chain Director, or senior supply chain leadership.


**Disclaimer:** 
*The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.*

**Work you’ll do:**
 The Contract Specialist will engage in contractual matters related to account\-level agreements and subordinate, engagement\-specific documents for complex information technology (IT) services (e.g.,Technology Preferred Provider (TPP) relationships and managed services). The Contract Specialist will provide support ranging from contractual compliance / administrative matters, contractual research related to business issues that intersect one or more contracts, and reviews of customized contract documents (Statements of Work (SOWs), Work Orders and Change Orders). The Contract Specialist will work closely with the US Risk Managers to help manage contractual matters related to client\-facing IT contracts and non\-standard subcontracting agreements.

The Contract Specialist will team with the US Risk Manager(s) to interact with other functions (e.g., Office of General Counsel (OGC); Information Security (InfoSec); Office of Confidentiality and Privacy (OCP); Contigence Workforce Services (CWS)) to orchestrate integrated support and guidance for Deloitte’s client teams to address policies and procedures, contractual obligations, and regulatory compliance, as applicable.

* Provide guidance and support to Deloitte account teams post contract execution for multi\-tiered contractual relationships for complex IT services (e.g.,TPP accounts and subordinate services engagements)
* Prepare MSA summaries (for business use), engagement summaries, obligations trackers, and contracting guidebooks
* Identify key contractual terms and requirements, including obligations and deliverables
* Periodically assess currency / compliance (together with the US Risk Manager(s)) and report on contractual obligations and deliverables

* Prepare analysis of potential options for resolution / response with contractual support provided

* Support US Risk Managers with contract closeout processes (including for partial terminations) by assisting with guidance to account / engagement PMOs for offboarding checklists; assist with document archival instructions and address return of confidential information, declaration of proprietary works, and transfer of software licenses

title: Director of Software Development India, Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies
description:
**Description**
 Interested in shaping the future of conversational and ambient AI at massive scale? Join the Alexa Ambient Computing Technologies (AACT) team. AACT's mission is to design, build, and operate the core horizontal services that power Alexa as the world's largest IoT installation and the most capable, efficient, and trusted AI assistant. We deliver the core capabilities that allow Alexa to connect, discover, set up, manage, and interface with over 1B connected endpoints (Echo, FireTV, Smart Home, Mobile, and Metis). Our work directly impacts every Alexa\+ customer interaction, and we're obsessed with making it fast, reliable, and efficient \- increasingly by putting generative AI and agentic systems at the center of how we build and operate.
   

  

 We're seeking a Director of Software Development to own all India\-based charters and teams. This role will manage AACT's charter and lead our teams based in Bangalore and Chennai consisting of SDMs, SDEs, TPMs, and SQEs. This leader will recruit and develop high\-caliber leaders and individuals and will set the standard for how an AI\-first engineering organization operates \- where large language models, agents, and AI\-assisted development are integral to strategy, execution, and day\-to\-day engineering.
   

  

 The successful candidate will demonstrate strong intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and creativity in solving complex, ambiguous technical problems, along with the ability to lead and scale large technical teams and influence across functions to drive results through others in a highly cross\-functional environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive technical strategy for critical initiatives — whether that's expanding Alexa into new modalities, enabling more fluid multi\-turn conversations, or evolving our inference and orchestration infrastructure to support both.
* As part of the AACT Senior Leadership team, set the India sites' strategy and lead software engineering teams.
* Own Operational Excellence (OE) for AACT India\-based charters — accountable for the availability, latency, security, and cost efficiency of the services your teams operate, including on\-call, incident response, COEs, and driving continuous operational improvements at scale.
* Champion the responsible adoption of generative AI and agentic tooling across the org — in the products you ship (LLM\-driven experiences, orchestration, inference) and in how your teams build (AI\-assisted coding, review, testing, and operations) — while owning the quality, safety, cost, and latency tradeoffs that come with it.
* Build the talent, mechanisms, and culture that let a large organization move quickly and safely with AI, raising engineering leverage and productivity without compromising customer trust or operational excellence.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience.
* 8\+ years of demonstrated experience managing senior engineering managers.
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead, or leading an engineering team.
* Experience collaborating across multiple organizations and influencing key outcomes.
* Experience as a technical leader of multiple concurrent projects, driving strategic technical decisions.
* Understanding software engineering practices and best practices for the full software development life cycle including coding standards, build processes, testing, and operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in computer science or related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading product and development teams, with a focus on customer service or user\-facing technologies.
* Experience in a lead role in bringing a product to market.
* Proven track record of taking emerging technologies from research to production\-ready solutions.
* Familiarity with generative AI models and their application in customer interactions and process automation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* AI Leadership Competencies \-We expect a director at this level to be fluent in AI as both a product capability and an engineering multiplier. Specifically:
* AI fluency and technical judgment — A working understanding of modern generative AI: LLMs, foundation models, prompting, fine\-tuning/RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and inference optimization. Able to engage credibly with scientists and senior engineers, ask the right questions.
* AI strategy and prioritization — Able to identify genuine, durable AI opportunities and to translate them into a prioritized, measurable roadmap tied to customer and business outcomes (latency, cost\-per\-interaction, trust).
* Driving AI\-assisted engineering productivity — Actively raises the leverage of the org by adopting AI\-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Sets expectations, mechanisms, and guardrails so teams use these tools effectively and consistently, and measures the impact on throughput and quality.
* Cost, latency, and scale economics of AI — Understands the economics of inference at scale and drives the right tradeoffs across model selection, orchestration, caching, and infrastructure to keep experiences fast, reliable, and efficient.
* Talent and culture for an AI\-first org — Attracts, develops, and retains leaders and builders who thrive in an AI\-native environment, and fosters a culture of experimentation, learning, and responsible innovation.
